name: ARK: Survival Ascended
description: The Unreal Engine 5 remake of ARK. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous); very large download, and the server binary is a Windows executable.

variables.label: Server name
variables.description: Avoid spaces and special characters — the name is passed inside the map argument string.

variables.label: Admin/RCON password
variables.description: Used for in-game admin (enablecheats) and Source RCON.

notes: The install always fetches the Windows depot (platformOverride) — on Linux hosts run it with Wine/Proton (GE-Proton is the community favourite); set the start command override to e.g. wine ShooterGame/Binaries/Win64/ArkAscendedServer.exe ... with the same arguments. ASA uses EOS for the server list (no A2S query); the panel stop sends the RCON command DoExit which saves the world (falls back to SIGTERM if RCON is unreachable). GameUserSettings.ini/Game.ini live under ShooterGame/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/, saves under ShooterGame/Saved/SavedArks/. The download is 30+ GB.
